groups.name: Mara Venn
groups.palette: muted river teal and aged bronze

skills.name: Oarhook
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Reach 2
skills.art: Exact broad wooden OAR PADDLE head from hero master, displayed upright with its SMALL plain iron U-hook at outer tip and red wrap at neck; two short ivory attack curls, no hand. Wooden paddle silhouette must dominate.

skills.name: River Footing
skills.effect: First Shift in an encounter grants Mara 5 Ward.
skills.art: ONE cloth-wrapped ferryman sandal/foot emblem matching master, resting within a tight river-knot shaped teal Ward curl. No modern boot, stone or ground scene.

skills.name: Undertow
skills.effect: CD 2 · Magic / Water · 80% ATK · Pull a surviving small enemy forward one slot when legal.
skills.art: ONE tightly coiled breaking river crest shaped like an inward hooked spiral. Three bold teal water lobes and ivory tips make a single powerful silhouette. No rope, boat, shoreline or target.

skills.name: Open Seam
skills.effect: CD 1 · Physical / Neutral · 70% ATK · Bleed 5 for 3 Round Ends.
skills.art: Exact WOODEN OAR PADDLE tip and its small iron U-hook angled across one thin red cut and three controlled red drops. Preserve wood blade even in closeup. No sickle, axe or bare metal crescent.

skills.name: Sound the Depths
skills.effect: CD 2 · Apply Wet for 2 Round Ends and reveal one enemy's trait.
skills.art: ONE large brass plumb weight on short cord, an eye-shaped teal ripple surrounds its lower point. Strong pendant silhouette; no hand, water surface, underwater view or landscape.

skills.name: Ferry Line
skills.effect: CD 2 · Swap two living allies when legal and grant each 8 Ward.
skills.art: TWO intertwined mooring-rope loops forming one compact symmetric exchange knot. Two tapered teal current strokes curl in opposite directions as secondary accent. No posts, hands, boat or map.

skills.name: Cut the Current
skills.effect: CD 3 · Magic / Water · 110% ATK · Consume Wet to weaken the enemy's next damaging action by 25% until Round End.
skills.art: Exact wooden paddle with small iron tip-hook, diagonally cutting a slender dark teal current ribbon and one split droplet. Wood paddle remains visible and recognizable, not a long metal water sword.

skills.name: Safe Passage
skills.effect: CD 4 · Party loses 5 Strain and gains one protection against the next eligible expedition hazard.
skills.art: ONE protective ferry talisman: a small shield-like wooden ferry ticket with an oar-shaped notch, enclosed by a broad calm teal shelter curl. Compact emblem, no actual ship, river or scenery.

groups.weaponSpec: Mara's exact weapon is a long WOODEN OAR: broad flattened angular wooden paddle blade, red cloth binding at neck, SMALL plain dark iron inverted-U hook attached at its outer tip with a rivet. MOST of weapon head is WOOD, not a metal axe! Match third image exactly. No crescent axe, sickle, ornamental gold hook, spear or bare iron blade. Her footwear is cloth-wrapped sandals, not armored boots.

groups.name: Rook Calder

skills.name: Mason's Blow
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Reach 1.
skills.art: Exact rectangular GREY STONE maul head with one BRASS middle band and TWO ROUND RIVETS on plain wood handle, upright weapon emblem, two thin ochre force curls. No cord wrapping around head.

skills.name: Load Bearing
skills.effect: Guard grants Rook 5 additional Ward within the cap.
skills.art: ONE load-bearing keystone emblem gripped between two short buttress wedges; broad capped silhouette, small downward amber chevron pressure accent. No building, construction scene or detailed bridge.

skills.name: Brace the Line
skills.effect: CD 2 · An adjacent ally gains 18 Ward.
skills.art: ONE large compact folding barricade shield front view, three joined stone panels with bamboo edging, two short protective ochre spirit curls. No floor, fortification landscape or person.

skills.name: Take the Weight
skills.effect: CD 2 · Intercept the next single-target hit against another ally before Round End.
skills.art: ONE raised armored gauntlet icon intercepting a dark falling shard; one curved ochre protection stroke behind palm. Crop at wrist. Gauntlet dominates, no second hand, ally, torso or environment.

skills.name: Split the Seal
skills.effect: CD 2 · Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Deal 12 extra damage to Ward only.
skills.art: Exact stone block and brass-band maul head intersects one cracked Ward medallion. Clear diagonal impact emblem, few ivory chips; no hands or ground.

skills.name: Anchor Step
skills.effect: CD 2 · Move Rook to the front when legal and resist forced movement until Round End.
skills.art: Wrapped plain work boot matching master presses one small anchor peg; short ochre locking crescent, no buckles, armor boot or environment.

skills.name: Stone Answer
skills.effect: CD 3 · Physical / Earth · 80% ATK plus half of Ward spent, spending up to 20 Ward.
skills.art: THREE pointed falling stone shards form a compact downward fan above a single jagged amber impact-star symbol. Dominant crystal-like silhouette, no ground plane, dust cloud or scene.

skills.name: Hold Until Dawn
skills.effect: CD 5 · Party gains 12 Ward and Rook gains 8 Strain.
skills.art: ONE broad stone shield emblem crowned by a small dawn disk, four distinct ivory ward-ray tips around its sides. Strong symmetric signature silhouette, no mountains, sky or battlefield.

groups.weaponSpec: Rook's exact maul has a squat RECTANGULAR GREY STONE block head with straight angled ends, one broad BRASS STRAP across its middle secured by TWO ROUND RIVETS, and a plain short brown wood handle. Match third image, no cord wrapped around hammer head, no ornate stone swirls, no fantasy axe or spiked club. His folding barricade is bamboo frame plus rough plain stone panels, no polished metal kite shield.

groups.name: Elian Reed

skills.name: Tuning Strike
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Reach 2.
skills.art: The exact small plain WOODEN rectangular tuning mallet crosses the simple uncarved brass bell from hero master, one thin ivory resonance arc. No hands or tuning fork.

skills.name: Measured Breath
skills.effect: The first successful cleanse each round also removes 2 Strain from its recipient.
skills.art: ONE small bronze bell nested inside one measured ivory breathing spiral, quiet compact asymmetric emblem. No landscape or person.

skills.name: Mending Note
skills.effect: CD 1 · Restore up to 24 HP to a living ally.
skills.art: ONE open bronze bell radiating three upward pale green/ivory healing-note leaves. Large bell silhouette, tiny light accents; no patient, hand, wound or anatomical heart.

skills.name: Quiet Circle
skills.effect: CD 3 · Two adjacent living allies each lose 10 Strain.
skills.art: TWO small bronze bells enclosed by one flat silver circular resonance band; two bells behave as a single paired emblem. No cloth canopy or background scene.

skills.name: Fracture Chime
skills.effect: CD 2 · Magic / Metal · 80% ATK · ARM -2 for 2 Round Ends within the cap.
skills.art: ONE tilted bell projects a jagged silver resonance crack across a small armor-plate fragment. Sharp broken silhouette, no hands, arm or full suit.

skills.name: Borrowed Breath
skills.effect: CD 2 · Grant another eligible ally a Strike die within pool limits; Elian gains 5 Strain.
skills.art: ONE carved strike die with a simple blade pictogram, suspended inside a slender ivory sound loop ending in a small bell lip. Die dominates, no hand or tabletop, no digits.

skills.name: Clear Tone
skills.effect: CD 2 · Remove one chosen eligible debuff from a living ally; excludes Downed and Fray.
skills.art: The simple plain BRASS BELL from hero master emits ONE fine straight bright resonance band that parts a dark purple curse knot into two ribbons. No tuning fork, hands or scene.

skills.name: Last Resonance
skills.effect: CD 5 · Revive one Downed ally at 20% Max HP, once per encounter; cancelled dice stay cancelled.
skills.art: ONE broken bronze bell rejoined by ivory spirit threads with a small upward soul-flame silhouette emerging through center. Majestic but compact sacred emblem, no human body or revival scene.

groups.weaponSpec: Elian's weapon is a SMALL PLAIN WOODEN tuning MALLET with rectangular light-brown head on a slender darker wood handle; his bell is PLAIN uncarved brass with stepped shoulders, broad flared lip and ROUND hanging clapper, on a square wooden support. Match third image. No elaborate floral bell carving, metal sledgehammer, tuning fork substituted as weapon, spear or sword.

groups.name: Tess Ashdown
groups.palette: deep jade green and faded red thread

skills.name: Courier's Shot
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Any enemy slot.
skills.art: Exact plain dark-brown asymmetrical wooden bow with ivory wrapped grip and red upper-limb tie from hero master; one narrow GREY arrow upright through center, two small green aiming curls. No gold bow ornament.

skills.name: Read the Route
skills.effect: First damaging action against a Marked enemy each round gains 3 direct damage before Guard and Ward.
skills.art: ONE red wax seal shaped like a watchful eye, with one short bent route-thread running behind it. Compact circular mark emblem. No map, landscape or fingers.

skills.name: Red Thread
skills.effect: CD 1 · Mark one enemy for 2 Round Ends; no damage.
skills.art: ONE vivid red-thread targeting knot over a dark small seal disk, two open loops and a pointed trailing strand. Very clear knot silhouette. No letter, hands or action scene.

skills.name: Pin the Hem
skills.effect: CD 2 · Physical / Wood · 80% ATK · Rooted for 1 Round End.
skills.art: ONE wood arrowhead pins a small cloth tab caught in a root-shaped loop. Compact diagonal arrow-and-root emblem. No foot, ground, tree or whole garment.

skills.name: Through the Gap
skills.effect: CD 2 · Physical / Neutral · 130% ATK · Ignore 50% ARM.
skills.art: One enlarged but STILL PLAIN NARROW GREY arrowhead matching hero master passes through a slit between two small armor fragments. No gilded ornate spearhead.

skills.name: False Address
skills.effect: CD 2 · Push a small enemy back one slot when legal; bosses are immune.
skills.art: ONE folded courier letter with a tiny mask-shaped wax seal and a backward curling green decoy trail. Letter is one large simple shape. No hand, road or mountains.

skills.name: Relay Signal
skills.effect: CD 2 · Change one unspent player die to Strike or Guard; no new die.
skills.art: ONE wood die face bearing a simple small pictogram of Tess's plain wrapped wooden bow, surrounded by red relay thread and a tiny shield outline at its edge. No numbered pips, spear or ornate sword.

skills.name: Final Delivery
skills.effect: CD 4 · Physical / Neutral · 160% ATK; consume Mark for an extra 30% ATK.
skills.art: One plain grey arrowhead with ivory fletching detail pierces a compact red wax knot, two snapped red strands flare out. Do not replace arrow with golden spear or new weapon.

groups.weaponSpec: Tess's exact bow is a PLAIN asymmetrical hand-carved DARK BROWN wooden courier bow, gently recurved tips, slim profile, IVORY CLOTH WRAP around center grip and RED CORD at upper limb. Ivory-fletched arrows with plain narrow grey arrowheads. Match third image. Not ornate symmetrical gold/green fantasy bow, crossbow or spear. Where arrowheads are cropped, preserve this same basic narrow grey arrow design.

groups.name: Nera Voss

skills.name: Kiln Rake
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Reach 2.
skills.art: Exact plain grey TWO-PRONG BLUNT U-shaped kiln rake head from hero master on brown wood shaft, upright tool emblem; two restrained orange ember curls. No ornamental etching, third tine or antler.

skills.name: Borrowed Warmth
skills.effect: First successful Burn application each round grants Nera 3 Ward; DOT ticks do not retrigger.
skills.art: ONE ember nestled in a broken ceramic cup, enclosed by a thin glowing ochre protective shell crescent. One cupped-coal emblem, no hands or realistic cooking scene.

skills.name: Cinder Wake
skills.effect: CD 2 · Magic / Fire · 80% ATK · Burn 4 for 2 Round Ends.
skills.art: Exact plain grey two-BLUNT-prong U-shaped rake head angled diagonally trailing one hooked cinder ribbon and a few ember sparks. Same head shape as first icon, no pointed crescent prongs.

skills.name: Banked Ember
skills.effect: CD 2 · Grant a living ally 10 Ward; no healing.
skills.art: ONE closed earthen ember pot fused visually with a protective ceramic shield rim, small quiet ember glint under lid. Compact symmetric emblem, no hands, table or scene.

skills.name: Cooling Breath
skills.effect: CD 2 · Remove Burn from one living ally who is burning; no healing.
skills.art: ONE large folded-open terracotta-colored fan disperses a single red ember with one pale cool curling breath. Fan dominates, no hand, floor or background scene.

skills.name: Open the Vent
skills.effect: CD 3 · Magic / Fire · 90% ATK · Reduce an interruptible active charge by one when allowed.
skills.art: ONE lifted ceramic vent grate, a concentrated orange pressure spear breaks through one incomplete charge ring above it. Compact vertical energy emblem, no furnace building, rake-operating hand or wall.

skills.name: Safe Fuel
skills.effect: CD 4 · Party loses 4 Strain and gains one nonstacking protection against an eligible Heat hazard.
skills.art: THREE clean black coals form one triangular emblem inside an earthen protection sigil, external red heat curls stop at rim. No basket, oven, hands or landscape.

skills.name: Last Coal
skills.effect: CD 5 · Magic / Fire · 140% ATK · Other living allies gain 8 Ward; Nera gains 8 Strain.
skills.art: ONE central last coal emits a long blazing spear, three ceramic crescent chips fan behind it like a protective crown. Dramatic sharp signature silhouette, no hands, allies or explosive scene.

groups.weaponSpec: Nera's exact kiln rake has a PLAIN DULL GREY U-shaped head with EXACTLY TWO THICK BLUNT flat-ended prongs; open slot between prongs, angled polygon edges and straight wooden shaft in a simple socket. Match third image EXACTLY. It is a work tool, NOT antler, trident, crescent axe, ornate curved four-spike weapon, fork of fire or golden staff. No decorative cutouts or gold curls added to rake.

groups.name: Gideon Rusk

skills.name: Writbreaker
skills.effect: Physical / Neutral · 100% ATK · Reach 1.
skills.art: Exact plain SHORT DARK-WOOD stamp baton with BRASS collar and BOX-SHAPED square terracotta head from master, end face a CONCENTRIC-SQUARE recess. Upright weapon emblem, no hand or ornate scepter.

skills.name: A Record Kept
skills.effect: First effective Ward grant to another ally each round also removes 2 Strain from them.
skills.art: ONE closed wood-bound ledger with a single ivory witness tab and a protective red binding knot across it. Diagonal strong rectangle, no hands, desk or scene.

skills.name: Stay of Claim
skills.effect: CD 2 · Root one eligible enemy for 1 Round End; no HP damage.
skills.art: Exact SQUARE clay stamp face with simple square-spiral recess anchors four taut red sealing ribbons into a root-like restraint emblem. No floral seal, boot, ground or writing.

skills.name: Counterseal
skills.effect: CD 1 · Grant a living ally 12 Ward; no healing.
skills.art: Exact BOX-SHAPED terracotta square stamp with dark wood handle and brass collar above plain wood-bound ledger-cover Ward emblem; a short protective ivory crescent. No round seal or invented carried metal shield.

skills.name: Open the Ledger
skills.effect: CD 2 · Magic / Earth · 70% ATK · ARM -2 for 2 Round Ends within the cap.
skills.art: Plain dark wood-bound ledger opens, a small angular armor-crack silhouette floats directly above spine. Ivory pages unlettered, simple clay square seal detail. No ornate gilded book.

skills.name: Return the Name
skills.effect: CD 2 · Remove one chosen eligible debuff from a living ally; excludes Downed and Fray.
skills.art: ONE ivory name tag breaks free from a split dark-red curse seal, one thin clean white release ribbon rising. Bold vertical tag emblem, no hand or text.

skills.name: Witness Copy
skills.effect: CD 3 · One ally blocks the next eligible new debuff before Round End; no damage protection.
skills.art: TWO overlapping ivory witness tabs form a small shield silhouette, a dark curse knot caught on front tab, back tab intact. Compact paired paper emblem, no fingers or scene.

skills.name: Release of Claim
skills.effect: CD 5 · All enemies lose up to 12 Ward and suffer ARM -2 until Round End; no HP damage; Gideon gains 6 Strain.
skills.art: Exact square terracotta stamp head with concentric-square recess at center, three broken red binding loops fanning outward. Short dark wood handle and brass collar may show. No round floral seal, ornate staff, hand or blast.

groups.weaponSpec: Gideon's exact short stamp baton is straight DARK WOOD with a simple BRASS rectangular collar and a BOX-SHAPED TERRACOTTA RED SQUARE head; its end face has a simple SQUARE SPIRAL/CONCENTRIC SQUARE recess, not letters or floral ornament. Match third image. Ledger is a PLAIN dark WOOD-BOUND rectangular book tied with rope and an octagonal red clay seal. Do not turn stamp into scepter, round seal, mace, golden carving or hammer.

skills.art: One tier bell radiating three green/ivory healing-note leaves, clear healing emblem not damage.

skills.name: Quiet Circle
skills.effect: CD 3 · Two adjacent living allies each lose 10 Strain.
skills.art: Two tier bells inside one silver circular quiet resonance band.

skills.name: Fracture Chime
skills.effect: CD 2 · Magic / Metal · 80% ATK · ARM -2 for 2 Round Ends within the cap.
skills.art: One tilted tier bell projects a jagged silver resonance crack through an armor fragment.

skills.name: Borrowed Breath
skills.effect: CD 2 · Grant another eligible ally a Strike die within pool limits; Elian gains 5 Strain.
skills.art: One carved strike die with blade pictogram inside ivory sound loop ending on small tier bell, no numbered pips.

skills.name: Clear Tone
skills.effect: CD 2 · Remove one chosen eligible debuff from a living ally; excludes Downed and Fray.
skills.art: Tier bell and matching short chime detail emit a bright clean resonance band dividing one purple curse-knot; no invented extra weapon.

skills.name: Last Resonance
skills.effect: CD 5 · Revive one Downed ally at 20% Max HP, once per encounter; cancelled dice stay cancelled.
skills.art: One fractured tier great-bell rejoined by ivory spirit threads, an upward soul-flame inside; symbolic not a character revival scene.

skills.name: Courier's Shot

skills.name: Through the Gap
skills.effect: CD 2 · Physical / Neutral · 130% ATK · Ignore 50% ARM.
skills.art: Tier arrowhead passes through a slit between two small armor-wing fragments; no long spear substitution.

skills.name: False Address
skills.effect: CD 2 · Push a small enemy back one slot when legal; bosses are immune.
